summary: Victory Capital filed an 8-K disclosing an August 25, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger to acquire First Eagle from GC Ferry Parent (Genstar-majority owned, with First Eagle management). Consideration is cash plus newly issued common stock equal to 4.9% of post-closing shares and a new Series B non-voting convertible preferred. Price adjusts for debt, cash, working capital and expenses, and is reduced if client consents fall below 92.5% of the base revenue run-rate, with a one-year true-up. Closing requires HSR clearance and other regulatory approvals. Watch client-consent thresholds, preferred overhang, and regulatory timing.
